thread:
carlos_mendoza: FYI launching MercurySwap migration POC. Customer wants minimal client change (vendor-old/v1/respond), parity on outputs, and a temporary predictable billing model during cutover. 2-week POC. Need SE + Security + Finance.

anya_petrov: Do we have their sample corpus? message arrays vs single prompt matters for token math. Also what's their p95 latency target?

carlos_mendoza: Samples uploaded to drive (~420 examples). Mostly chat arrays. They asked for 250ms p95 but will accept up to 600ms during cutover.

lee_wang: Proposed plan: 1) small compat shim mapping vendor envelope to our chat API; 2) deterministic harness (temp=0, top_p=1); 3) response-normalizer to canonicalize dates/currency/whitespace; 4) run 500 A/B pairs and produce semantic-similarity + token-delta report.

sophie_lee: Mapping example I'll share with their engineers:
```
# vendor call
POST /v1/respond {"input":"Explain fees","limit":120}
# shim -> redwood
POST /v1/chat.complete {"model":"redwood-chat-1","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Explain fees"}],"max_tokens":120,"temperature":0}
```
Keeps client code nearly identical.

nisha_verma: Security checklist: EU data residency flagged, BYOK via Azure Key Vault requested, 12mo audit log retention, signed DPA. Need staging allowlist IPs and contact at their security team. I'll draft questionnaire answers.

lee_wang: For parity runs we should lock RNG and capture full tokenization (both sides) so finance can see exact billing diffs.

carlos_mendoza: Finance asked for two artifacts: 1) flat per-call migration quote for the POC window; 2) tokenized comparison projecting long-term costs at their QPS.

anya_petrov: They requested a smoke on Thu 07:00-08:30 UTC. Can we aim for that?

deploy-bot: staging environment "mercuryswap-poc" provisioned in eu-west-1. Firewall template created; awaiting allowlist.

sophie_lee: I'll own the eval harness + normalization code and post the diff report. Will include top-3 failure cases and remediation suggestions (canonicalizer rules).

nisha_verma: Blockers from security: EU key residency for CMKs may force Dedicated/Private; DPA signature; and explicit KMS flow doc. If those are OK, no blockers.

lee_wang: I'll prepare shim PR and run an initial 100-sample smoke today. If token inflation shows up, we'll try quantized model variant and batching tweaks.

carlos_mendoza: Action items: lee=shim+smoke, sophie=eval harness, nisha=sec Qs, anya=flat-rate quote with 3 sample token counts. I'll notify customer and schedule Thu smoke. Marking thread active.
